title: crepidium glabrum
intro: Crepidium glabrum, commonly known as the Slender Pouch Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and alleviate symptoms of fever, due to its therapeutic actions as a diaphoretic and vasodilator. The bioactive constituents of Crepidium glabrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Crepidium glabrum for medicinal purposes.
